```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
links <- c(donnees='catalogue.html',activite='activites.html',document='lectures.html',application='applications.html')
labels <- c(donnees='Jeux de données',activite='Activités',document='Lectures et documents',application='Applications')
cat('<nav class="home-resource-links" aria-label="Types de ressources">')
for (type in names(links)) cat('<a href="',links[type],'">',resource_type_badge(type),'<span>',labels[type],'</span><small>',as.integer(counts[type]),if(counts[type] == 1) ' ressource</small></a>' else ' ressources</small></a>',sep='')
cat('</nav>')
```

## Quelques jeux de données

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat('<div class="home-featured-grid">')
for (id in c('arbres-quebec','bixi','empress-of-ireland')) {
  item <- metadata[[id]]
  candidates <- file.path('assets/cards',paste0(id,c('.webp','.jpg','.jpeg','.png')))
  image <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
  if (is.na(image)) image <- 'assets/cards/catalogue.png'
  cat('<article class="home-dataset-card"><img src="',catalogue_escape(image),'" alt="" loading="lazy" width="640" height="360">',
      '<h3><a href="datasets/',id,'/fiche.html">',catalogue_escape(item$title),'</a></h3>',
      '<p>',catalogue_escape(item$summary),'</p></article>',sep='')
}
cat('</div>')
```
